notes.title: 1 Day Until Release!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ejm5JxwiIZ4&t=24s

Laura - There The Light OST prod. Hash Brown


Everything has been checked over and the final build has been uploaded: There The Light releases tomorrow! I can't believe I'm saying this, it's been a long journey but it's almost out. Huge thanks to everyone who helped out along the way, there's no way this game would exist without you.

And thanks to everyone that joined the community or wishlisted the game, hopefully it can live up to expectations, and hopefully we can get some interesting community discussions going!


I've also set up a Discord server for CasualBebop, so if your interested join in! It would be great to speak to you :)

https://discord.gg/qGEQMPR


I am starting to get ideas together for my next project, it's proving to be a really good distraction from being a nervous wreck. There's not much to say or show at the moment, but if you are interested, the best place to find out more is via my website:

https://casualbebop.com/untitled


Hope you all have a great day, all the love

CasualBebop

notes.title: 2 Weeks Until Release
notes.notes:
Hi all hope you are good. It's been a good few weeks putting everything together for the final build, happy to say that everything is done!! So the last 2 weeks will be spent on tweaks and polish, to try and get There The Light playing as good as possible.

Yup, 2 weeks until release!! Ahhh it's scary, but very exciting. It's pretty crazy looking back at the first prototype of the game, going over the old notebooks and sketchbooks. So many iterations, so many builds!

Anywhoo, hope you all have a good week going foward,

All the love

CasualBebop
